tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Sandooq's subscription plan, its base price and limits, and the add-on prices per extra store and staff login, read from the same source the pricing page renders.

tools.name: get_country_info
tools.description: What Sandooq publishes about one MENA market: VAT rate, e-invoicing posture, currency, how tenders are handled, the regulator, and the market notes shown on that country's page.

tools.name: search_docs

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One Sandooq page as Markdown — the same representation the site serves at /agent and via Accept: text/markdown, with no HTML or navigation chrome.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Sandooq's subscription plans, prices and per-plan limits, read from the same source the pricing page renders." → after: "Sandooq's subscription plan, its base price and limits, and the add-on prices per extra store and staff login, read from the same source the pricing page renders."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
